title: Krakow · Tatra Foothills and Zakopane
slogan: A 202 km loop out of Myślenice fuel
story: Mountain views, villages and traffic-aware timing. A 202 km loop that starts and ends near Myślenice, about 3 h 29 of riding. It goes by way of Chochołów wooden village, Zakopane and Gubałówka view area. The highest point is about 1,050 m. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.
